objective: Reduce destructive disposable calibration interventions by using already frozen confidence criteria to stop early, while preserving accuracy; expose fail-after-switch risk.
model_training: Same normal collect train/0..79 and reversed route-reversed train/300..379 80 episodes each from previous precommitted study.

calibration.criterion: Existing OutcomeCalibration.decision chosen != abstain, using unchanged minimum 4 observations and log likelihood gap >=2.0.
calibration.forced4: Stop after exactly 4 probes and preserve any abstention.
calibration.mixed_shift: First 4 probe episodes use normal route dynamics, later probes use reversed route dynamics; evaluation uses reversed route; early stopping may produce stale calibration.

controls: Calibration histories remain public and train-only
All six seeds already inspected, NOT blind
All intervention damage counts including in the disposable simulator
No real-world experimentation authorization, model promotion or integration
nonclaims: Earlier stopping can mistakenly commit before a future environment switch
The two possible consequence rules are hand-designed and learned beforehand
No per-action safe information exploration guarantee
Probe harm is not mitigated merely because a simulator is disposable
Not general AI or autonomous novel causal discovery
